question: In Windows 10/11, which shortcut key combination allows a user to cycle through apps on the Taskbar in the order they are pinned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Windows Key + T**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 

 
 
• The **Windows Key + T** shortcut is used in **Windows 10/11** to cycle through applications pinned on the Taskbar sequentially. This functionality enhances productivity by allowing users to easily navigate apps without using a mouse. 
 
• When you press **Windows Key + T**, the focus shifts to the first pinned app on the Taskbar. Subsequent presses move the focus to the next app in the sequence. 
 
• Once the desired app is highlighted, you can press **Enter** to open it or activate it if it is already running.
